days.title: Northern Lakes and Research Area
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Suomunjärvi
stops.detail: Remaining were a largely sandy subsoil and several lakes surrounded by sandy shores, the largest of which is the Suomunjärvi in the north of the national park.

stops.name: Hietajärvi
stops.detail: In the north of the national park, the area of Lake Hietajärvi is one of four Finnish research areas under the International Cooperative Program on Integrated Monitoring of Air Pollution Effects on Ecosystems led by the United Nations Economic Commission for Europe.

days.title: Central Mires and Ancient Forests
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Patvinsuo
stops.detail: The central part of the extensive Patvinsuo consists of aapa mires, which receive nutrients from the surrounding forest areas during the annual snowmelt and can thus accommodate a more diverse vegetation than the raised bog areas.

stops.name: Hietavaara
stops.detail: On the Hietavaara hill, trees up to 200 years old can be found, whose scars show that they have survived several large forest fires.

days.title: Southern Waterways and Boundaries
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Nälmänjoki
stops.detail: The largest of them is the Nälmänjoki, which flows south from the rocky lake Nälmänjärvi into the Koitere.

stops.name: Koitere
stops.detail: The area of Patvinsuo borders the lake Koitere in the south.
